describe.description: A large quadrupedal creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of bare, rocky ground with sparse tufts of dry grass. Its rear body, torso, legs and tail are covered in short tawny-brown fur with a paler cream underbelly and inner legs, like that of a large feline, while its head, neck, chest and two large outstretched wings are covered in dense overlapping feathers in shades of golden-brown, dark brown, tan and cream. The head at the front has a hooked beak that is yellow at the base and dark gray at the down-curved tip, a yellow eye with a dark pupil, and golden-brown feathering. The wings rise from the upper back behind the feathered chest and are spread wide, showing layered flight feathers with darker tips and paler undersides. A long slender tail with a dark tuft at the tip hangs down behind the hind legs on the left side of the image.

describe.description: A large standing quadruped in side view facing right that combines a bird of prey in front with a big cat behind. The head, hooked beak, feathered neck and chest, and two large outstretched feathered wings are eagle-like in brown, golden-brown, cream and dark brown. The mid-body, hindquarters, four sturdy legs with feline paws, and long slender tail ending in a dark tuft are lion-like with short tawny fur. The wings are raised and spread above the back and the animal stands on a small patch of bare ground.
